name: Wrapping Up a Meeting
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on wrapping up a meeting -- practice these key phrases out loud:
Let's recap the key decisions before we close.
So, to summarize, the next steps are...
I'll send a follow-up email with action items by end of day.
Thanks everyone, that was a productive session.
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
